areas.description: A large, round green front door to the halfling home.

The main living room. It has a fireplace in the south wall and a round window about 4 feet in diameter in the north. There is no furniture. The room smells of death. A long-dead mauled body in rotten leather armor lies in the center; it carries a silver dagger in a belt sheath, 2 vials of holy water, 1 Potion of Healing, and a leather pouch with 3 cp. A tentacle worm lurks here and scuttles toward sounds in adjacent rooms, such as the front door being knocked in.
treasure: Old ornate jewelry box hidden in a small secret niche in the fireplace containing 100 gp, a gem worth 250 gp, and a large silver hat pin that was once magical but is no longer
features: Small secret niche in the fireplace

areas.description: A 15 by 17 foot dining room with two round windows in the north wall. Dust and floor discoloration show where tables and chairs once stood in the window light.
features: Two round windows in the north wall

areas.description: A kitchen with a stone stove against the north wall and a chimney through the roof with a flue about 1 foot square. There are no other furnishings. A round window about 4 feet in diameter is in the northwest corner; its glass is broken out. A pool of slimy green water runs down the sill to the floor, looking exactly like a green slime monster but actually harmless.
features: Chimney with flue about 1 foot square
Round window in northwest corner with broken glass
Pool of harmless slimy green water on sill and floor

areas.description: An empty bedroom with no furniture. It has a round window about 4 feet in diameter in the south wall.
An empty bedroom with no furniture. It has a round window about 4 feet in diameter in the south wall.
An empty bedroom with no furniture. It has a round window about 4 feet in diameter in the southwest corner.
A simple round back door about 5 feet high with old, peeling red paint. It is barred from the inside and is old and easily knocked in.
An old tree house, a simple square platform about 20 feet up from the ground and perhaps 6 feet from floor to ceiling. Fire beetles have taken up residence here and scuttle or jump down to attack.
features: Tree house about 20 feet above ground
Interior about 6 feet from floor to ceiling

areas.description: A shed north of the house entered through double doors in another mound. The floor is dirt, the wall frames are heavy stone blocks, and the ceiling is made of heavy wooden timbers. The east, north, and west walls have round windows about 3 feet in diameter with shutters instead of glass; the north window is broken and smeared with splattered feces. Two empty pony stalls stand at the west end. The east end once held carts and stored goods. Several piles of once-sacked grain lie moldering under harmless yellow fungus. The floor is covered in stinking feces.
features: Round shuttered windows in east, north, and west walls
Broken north window smeared with feces
Moldering grain sacks covered in harmless yellow fungus

areas.description: A mound of earth overgrown with brush and weeds, unlike the other buildings. Square stones in loose earth near the main entrance suggest something buried here. Digging for an hour or two will reach the buried house. Searching on top reveals the small one-foot-square chimney to the fireplace in H12. All windows and doors are buried. The two main doors are boarded shut with a great deal of lumber, apparently out of fear.
features: Overgrown mound with brush and weeds
Square stones near main entrance hint at buried structure
Small one-foot-square chimney to the fireplace in H12 visible on top
All windows and doors are buried
Two main doors are heavily boarded shut

areas.description: An unfurnished living room with a brick fireplace in the northwest corner. Four humanoid shapes swaddled in cloth lie on the floor; they are zombies that rise and attack if anyone enters the home.
A kitchen crammed with two cozy chairs, a couch, a table, six wooden chairs, cupboards, a stove, and other furnishings.

The master bedroom contains a bed, dresser, and writing table. A zombie in tattered clothes sits behind the table; its exposed features are putrid and ragged from wounds and age. It attacks intruders with a flail used as a war hammer, growling in hatred of the living. The zombie has a massive hole in its back as if killed by a particularly brutal sword wound. Several sheets of old paper on the desk are covered with many different badly composed poems to "Kylenne My Lady Love" mixed with the name "Tyrok the Indefatigable." The writer was obviously disturbed and evil.
features: Old papers with poems to "Kylenne My Lady Love" and the name "Tyrok the Indefatigable"

areas.description: A guest room containing a bed, table, small dresser, and a few other furnishings.
